CREATE VIEW BMD.DBA_CONS_COLUMNS AS SELECT TABLE_NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS TABLE_NAME,        TABLE_SCHEMA COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS OWNER,       CONSTRAINT_NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CONSTRAINT_NAME,       COLUMN_NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE CONSTRAINT_NAME LIKE 'FK%'  UNION SELECT F.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS TABLE_NAME,        C.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS OWNER,        D.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CONSTRAINT_NAME,        B.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS COLUMN_NAME FROM SYSINDEXKEYS A, SYSCOLUMNS B, SYS.SCHEMAS C, SYSINDEXES D, SYSOBJECTS E, SYSOBJECTS F WHERE A.ID = B.ID AND A.COLID = B.COLID AND A.INDID = D.INDID AND A.ID = D.ID AND D.NAME = E.NAME AND E.UID = C.SCHEMA_ID AND A.ID = F.ID

CREATE VIEW BMD.DBA_IND_COLUMNS AS  SELECT E.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS INDEX_OWNER,  C.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS INDEX_NAME,  A.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS COLUMN_NAME,  B.KEYNO AS COLUMN_POSITION,  D.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS TABLE_NAME,  DESCEND = case indexkey_property(A.ID,B.INDID,B.KEYNO,'IsDescending')  WHEN 1 THEN'DESC' WHEN NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'ASC' END, UNIQUENESS = case indexproperty(A.ID, C.NAME, 'IsUnique')  WHEN 1 THEN 'ISUNIQUE' WHEN NULL THEN NULL  ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END  FROM SYSCOLUMNS A, SYSINDEXKEYS B, SYSINDEXES C, SYSOBJECTS D, SYS.SCHEMAS E  WHERE  A.ID = B.ID AND  A.COLID = B.COLID AND  B.ID = C.ID AND  D.ID = A.ID AND  E.SCHEMA_ID = D.UID AND  B.INDID = C.INDID AND  C.INDID > 0

CREATE VIEW BMD.DBL_DBINFO_LOCKS AS SELECT TL.resource_type AS DBI_RESTYPE ,TL.resource_description AS DBI_RESDESCR ,TL.request_mode AS DBI_REQMODE ,TL.request_type AS DBI_REQTYPE ,TL.request_status AS DBI_REQSTATUS ,TL.request_owner_type AS DBI_REQOWNERTYPE ,TAT.name AS DBI_TRANSNAME ,TAT.transaction_begin_time AS DBI_TRANSBEGIN ,DATEDIFF(ss, TAT.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()) AS DBI_TRANSDURA ,ES.session_id AS SESSION_Id ,ES.login_name AS LOGINAME ,COALESCE(OBJ.name, PAROBJ1.name) AS DBI_OBJECTNAME ,PARIDX1.name AS DBI_INDEXNAME ,ES.host_name AS HOSTNAME ,ES.program_name AS PROGRAM FROM sys.dm_tran_locks AS TL INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS ES ON TL.request_session_id = ES.session_id LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions AS TAT ON TL.request_owner_id = TAT.transaction_id LEFT JOIN sys.objects AS OBJ ON TL.resource_associated_entity_id = OBJ.object_id AND TL.resource_type = 'OBJECT' LEFT JOIN sys.partitions AS PAR ON TL.resource_associated_entity_id = PAR.hobt_id AND TL.resource_type IN ('PAGE', 'KEY', 'RID', 'HOBT') LEFT JOIN sys.objects AS PAROBJ1 ON PAR.object_id = PAROBJ1.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.indexes AS PARIDX1 ON PAR.object_id = PARIDX1.object_id AND PAR.index_id = PARIDX1.index_id WHERE TL.resource_database_id = DB_ID()

CREATE VIEW BMD.DBU_VA_DBMAINMEMUSAGE AS SELECT database_id, [DBU_NAME] = CASE [database_id] WHEN 32767 THEN 'Resource DB' ELSE DB_NAME([database_id]) END, db_buffer_pages DBU_BUFFER_PAGES, DBU_BUFFER_MB = db_buffer_pages / 128, DBU_BUFFER_PERCENT = CONVERT(DECIMAL(6,3), db_buffer_pages * 100.0 / (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM([object_name]) LIKE '%Buffer Manager' AND counter_name = 'Database Pages')) FROM (SELECT database_id, db_buffer_pages = COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors GROUP BY database_id) as src

Create VIEW BMD.OBU_VA_OBJECTUSAGE AS SELECT S.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS SCHEMANAME, T.NAME COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DBI_DBINFO_TABLENAME, P.ROWS AS DBI_ROWCOUNT, CAST(ROUND((SUM(A.USED_PAGES) / 128.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS DBI_USED_MB, CAST(ROUND((SUM(A.TOTAL_PAGES) - SUM(A.USED_PAGES)) / 128.00, 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS DBI_UNUSED_MB, CAST(ROUND((SUM(A.TOTAL_PAGES) / 128.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS DBI_TOTAL_MB FROM SYS.TABLES T INNER JOIN SYS.INDEXES I ON T.OBJECT_ID = I.OBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SYS.PARTITIONS P ON I.OBJECT_ID = P.OBJECT_ID AND I.INDEX_ID = P.INDEX_ID INNER JOIN SYS.ALLOCATION_UNITS A ON P.PARTITION_ID = A.CONTAINER_ID INNER JOIN SYS.SCHEMAS S ON T.SCHEMA_ID = S.SCHEMA_ID GROUP BY T.NAME, S.NAME, P.ROWS

create view BMD.VMP_VIEW_PROTOKOLLMAXIMUM as select * from BMD.REC_RECORDINTERVALL I where REC_RECLFDNR = (select MAX(REC_RECLFDNR) from BMD.REC_RECORDINTERVALL I1 where I1.REC_PROTGRUPPE = I.REC_PROTGRUPPE and I1.REC_PROTTYPE = I.REC_PROTTYPE and (I1.REC_BISDATUM is null or I1.REC_VONDATUM = (SELECT MAX(I2.REC_VONDATUM) from BMD.REC_RECORDINTERVALL I2 where I2.REC_PROTGRUPPE = I1.REC_PROTGRUPPE and I2.REC_PROTTYPE = I1.REC_PROTTYPE) ) )

CREATE VIEW BMDDEFAULT.VPL_V_POSSIBLE_LINK_SRC AS SELECT DCP_CONSTRAINTNAME VPL_CONSTRAINT_NAME, DCP_CHILDOWNER VPL_OWNER, DCP_CHILDTABLE VPL_TABLE_NAME, DCP_CHILDCOLUMN VPL_COLUMN_NAME, R_TABLE_NAME VPL_R_TABLE_NAME, R_COLUMN_NAME VPL_R_COLUMN_NAME, NULL VPL_CONDITION, 6 VPL_PRIORITAET FROM BMDDEFAULT.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TYPE='R' UNION SELECT L.DLK_LINKNAME VPL_CONSTRAINT_NAME, FB1.DBT_DBSCHEMA VPL_OWNER, L.DLK_VON_TABELLENNAME VPL_TABLE_NAME, FB1.DBT_FELDNAME VPL_COLUMN_NAME, LF.DLF_LINKFIELDNR VPL_POSITION, FB2.DBT_DBSCHEMA VPL_R_OWNER, L.DLK_NACH_TABELLENNAME VPL_R_TABLE_NAME, FB2.DBT_FELDNAME VPL_R_COLUMN_NAME, L.DLK_LINKBEDINGUNG VPL_CONDITION, L.DLK_PRIORITAET VPL_PRIORITAET FROM BMDDEFAULT.DLK_LINK L, BMDDEFAULT.DLF_LINKFIELD LF, BMDDEFAULT.DBT_DBMDTABFELDBESCH FB1, BMDDEFAULT.DBT_DBMDTABFELDBESCH FB2 WHERE L.DLK_GENERIERT = 2 AND L.DLK_LINKNR = LF.DLF_LINKNR AND FB1.DBT_TABELLENNAME = L.DLK_VON_TABELLENNAME AND DBT_TABELLENNAME VPL_CONSTRAINT_NAME, DBT_DBSCHEMA VPL_OWNER, DBT_TABELLENNAME VPL_TABLE_NAME, DBT_FELDNAME VPL_COLUMN_NAME, 1 VPL_POSITION, 'BMD' VPL_R_OWNER, 'BMU_BMDUSER' VPL_R_TABLE_NAME, CREATE VIEW BUERO.V12_VIEW_AVTAGEINFO ( V12_VIEW_FIRMENNR, V12_VIEW_VSTAMMNR, V12_VIEW_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, V12_VIEW_BEGINN, V12_VIEW_BEGINN_UHRZEIT, V12_VIEW_ENDE, V12_VIEW_ENDE_UHRZEIT, V12_ANZAHLTAGE) AS SELECT BEGINN.VET_FIRMENNR, BEGINN.VET_VSTAMMNR, BEGINN.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, BEGINN.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM, BEGINN.VET_UHRZEITVON, ENDE.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM, ENDE.VET_UHRZEITBIS, ANZAHL.VET_ANZAHL FROM ( SELECT SD.VET_FIRMENNR, SD.VET_VSTAMMNR, SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM, MIN(SD.VET_UHRZEITVON) AS VET_UHRZEITVON FROM BUERO.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSTAG SD, ( SELECT SA.VET_FIRMENNR, SA.VET_VSTAMMNR, SA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, MIN(SA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM) AS VET_MIN FROM BUERO.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSTAG SA GROUP BY SA.VET_FIRMENNR, SA.VET_VSTAMMNR, SA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR ) MI WHERE SD.VET_FIRMENNR = MI.VET_FIRMENNR AND SD.VET_VSTAMMNR = MI.VET_VSTAMMNR AND SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR = MI.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR AND SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM = MI.VET_MIN GROUP BY SD.VET_FIRMENNR, SD.VET_VSTAMMNR, SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, SD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM ) BEGINN, ( SELECT XD.VET_FIRMENNR, XD.VET_VSTAMMNR, XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM, MAX(XD.VET_UHRZEITBIS) AS VET_UHRZEITBIS FROM BUERO.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSTAG XD, ( SELECT XA.VET_FIRMENNR, XA.VET_VSTAMMNR, XA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, MAX(XA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM) AS VET_MAX FROM BUERO.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSTAG XA GROUP BY XA.VET_FIRMENNR, XA.VET_VSTAMMNR, XA.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR ) MX WHERE XD.VET_FIRMENNR = MX.VET_FIRMENNR AND XD.VET_VSTAMMNR = MX.VET_VSTAMMNR AND XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR = MX.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR AND XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM = MX.VET_MAX GROUP BY XD.VET_FIRMENNR, XD.VET_VSTAMMNR, XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, XD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSDATUM ) ENDE, ( SELECT AD.VET_FIRMENNR, AD.VET_VSTAMMNR, AD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR, COUNT(*) AS VET_ANZAHL FROM BUERO.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSTAG AD GROUP BY AD.VET_FIRMENNR, AD.VET_VSTAMMNR, AD.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR ) ANZAHL WHERE BEGINN.VET_FIRMENNR = ENDE.VET_FIRMENNR AND BEGINN.VET_VSTAMMNR = ENDE.VET_VSTAMMNR AND BEGINN.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR = ENDE.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR AND BEGINN.VET_FIRMENNR = ANZAHL.VET_FIRMENNR AND BEGINN.VET_VSTAMMNR = ANZAHL.VET_VSTAMMNR AND BEGINN.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR = ANZAHL.VET_VERANSTALTUNGSNR

ISNULL(PSM.PSM_KALTAGE_ENTOHNE, 0) - ISNULL(PSM.PSM_KALTAGE_ENTVIERTEL, 0) - ISNULL(PSM.PSM_KALTAGE_TRUPPENUEB, 0) - ISNULL(PSM.PSM_KALTAGE_UNBEZURLAUB, 0)) > 0) THEN ISNULL(PSM.PSM_KALENDERTAGE, 0) - CREATE VIEW HRS.VZ1_VA_ABWESENHEIT_MONAT AS SELECT PSJ.PSJ_FIRMENNR AS "VZ1_PSJ_FIRMENNR", PSJ.PSJ_MITARBEITERID AS "VZ1_PSJ_MITARBEITERID", PSJ.PSJ_DIENSTVLFDNR AS "VZ1_PSJ_DIENSTVLFDNR", ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM AS "VZ1_ABN_TAGESDATUM", SUM( CASE WHEN ABN.ABN_ABWESENHEITART IN (2,3,4) THEN (ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT1_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT2_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT3_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT4_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT_OE_VERWALTUNG)) ELSE 0 END) AS "VZ1_SUM_KRANK_UNFALL", SUM( CASE WHEN ABN.ABN_ABWESENHEITART IN (1,6) THEN (ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT1_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT2_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT3_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT4_VERWALTUNG)) ELSE 0 END) AS "VZ1_SUM_URLAUB_PFLEGEURLAUB", MONTH(ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM) AS "VZ1_PSM_MONAT", YEAR(ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM) AS "VZ1_PSM_JAHR" FROM HRS.ABN_ABWESENHEIT_TAG ABN, HRS.PSJ_PERSONALSTAMM_JAHR PSJ WHERE ABN.ABN_ABMID IN ( SELECT ABM.ABM_ABMID FROM HRS.ABM_ABWESENHEIT ABM WHERE ABM.ABM_PSJ_FIRMENNR = PSJ.PSJ_FIRMENNR AND ABM.ABM_PSJ_MITARBEITERID = PSJ.PSJ_MITARBEITERID AND ABM.ABM_PSJ_LOHNJAHR = PSJ.PSJ_LOHNJAHR AND ABM.ABM_PSJ_DIENSTVLFDNR = PSJ.PSJ_DIENSTVLFDNR ) AND ABN.ABN_ANSPRVERBRKZ <> 2 AND ABN.ABN_ABWESENHEITART IN (1,2,3,4,6) GROUP BY PSJ.PSJ_FIRMENNR, PSJ.PSJ_MITARBEITERID, PSJ.PSJ_DIENSTVLFDNR, ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM, MONTH(ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM), YEAR(ABN.ABN_TAGESDATUM) HAVING SUM(ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT1_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT2_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT3_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT4_VERWALTUNG) + ABS(ABN.ABN_WERT_OE_VERWALTUNG)) <> 0

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.AGC_VIEW_AG_PERSON_CHECK AS SELECT AGM.AGM_PPSKAPAID AS AGC_AG_ID, COUNT(1) AS AGC_POSITIONS, COUNT(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 OR AGM_PER_PERSONENID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 1 END) AS AGC_VALID, COUNT(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGC_DELETED, COUNT(CASE WHEN (AGM_LOESCHEN IS NULL OR AGM_LOESCHEN = 0) AND AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGC_OPTIONAL, COUNT(CASE WHEN (AGM_LOESCHEN IS NULL OR AGM_LOESCHEN = 0) AND (AGM_VORMERKEN IS NULL OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 0) AND AGM_PER_PERSONENID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGC_MISSING, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_DAUER END) AS AGC_SOLL_DAUER, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_DAUER END) AS AGC_V_SOLL_DAUER, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_KOSTEN END) AS AGC_SOLL_KOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_KOSTEN END) AS AGC_V_SOLL_KOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN END) AS AGC_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN END) AS AGC_V_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_ERLOES END) AS AGC_SOLL_ERLOES, SUM (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGM_SOLL_ERLOES END) AS AGC_V_SOLL_ERLOES, MIN (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_STATUS END) AS AGC_MIN_STATUS, MIN (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_STATUS END) AS AGC_V_MIN_STATUS, MAX (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_STATUS END) AS AGC_MAX_STATUS, MAX (CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_STATUS END) AS AGC_V_MAX_STATUS, MIN(AGM_SOLL_START) AS AGC_MIN_SOLL_START, MIN(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_SOLL_START END) AS AGC_C_MIN_SOLL_START, MIN(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_SOLL_START END) AS AGC_V_MIN_SOLL_START, MAX(AGM_SOLL_ENDE) AS AGC_MAX_SOLL_ENDE, MAX(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGM_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_SOLL_ENDE END) AS AGC_C_MAX_SOLL_ENDE, MAX(CASE WHEN AGM_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGM_SOLL_ENDE END) AS AGC_V_MAX_SOLL_ENDE FROM PRODUKTION.AGM_AG_PERSON_ZU AGM GROUP BY AGM.AGM_PPSKAPAID

create VIEW PRODUKTION.APW_VIEW_AG_PER_WERTE AS SELECT plw.agm_ppskapaid AS apw_ppskapaid , plw.agm_per_firmennr AS apw_per_firmennr , plw.AGM_PER_PERSONENID AS apw_per_personenid , plw.agm_count AS apw_agm_count , plw.agm_count_mx AS apw_agm_count_mx , cast (plw.agm_soll_dauer AS FLOAT) AS apw_sum_soll_dauer , ISW.LEI_LEIST_MENGE AS APW_SUM_IST_DAUER , ISW.LEI_HONORAR AS APW_SUM_IST_ERLOES , ISW.LEI_SELBSTKOSTEN AS APW_SUM_IST_VOLLKOSTEN , isw.lei_herstellkosten AS apw_sum_ist_kosten , isw.lei_vzeit AS apw_ist_start_lea , isw.lei_bzeit AS apw_ist_ende_lea FROM (SELECT agm_ppskapaid , agm_per_firmennr , AGM_PER_PERSONENID , count(*) AS agm_count , SUM(CASE WHEN AGM_AGPERSONZULFDNR < 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as agm_count_mx , sum(agm_soll_dauer) AS agm_soll_dauer FROM produktion.agm_ag_person_zu where AGM_PER_FIRMENNR IS NOT NULL AND AGM_PER_PERSONENID IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(AGM_LOESCHEN, 0) = 0 GROUP BY agm_ppskapaid , agm_per_firmennr , AGM_PER_PERSONENID) plw JOIN (SELECT lei_ppskapaid , LEI_MIT_FIRMENNR , LEI_MIT_MITARBEITERID , sum(LEI_LEIST_MENGE) AS lei_leist_menge , sum(LEI_HONORAR) AS Lei_Honorar , sum(LEI_SELBSTKOSTEN) AS lei_selbstkosten , sum(LEI_HERSTELLSATZ * LEI_LEIST_MENGE / 3600) AS lei_herstellkosten , min(isnull(LEI_VZEIT, LEI_LEISTUNGSDATUM)) AS lei_vzeit , max(isnull(LEI_BZEIT, LEI_LEISTUNGSDATUM + 1)) AS lei_bzeit FROM ZLE.LEI_LEISTUNG WHERE LEI_PPSKAPAID IS NOT NULL AND LEI_MIT_FIRMENNR IS NOT NULL AND LEI_MIT_MITARBEITERID IS NOT NULL AND LEI_ISTZEITEINGABE = 1 GROUP BY LEI_PPSKAPAID , LEI_MIT_FIRMENNR , LEI_MIT_MITARBEITERID) ISW ON (plw.agm_ppskapaid = isw.lei_ppskapaid AND plw.agm_per_firmennr = isw.LEI_MIT_FIRMENNR AND plw.AGM_PER_PERSONENID = isw.LEI_MIT_MITARBEITERID)

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.EDM_VA_EPS_DIS_MENGEN AS (SELECT EDMI.*, EDMI.EDM_QTY_SOLL / CASE WHEN (EDMI.EDM_QTY_EINZEL = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE EDMI.EDM_QTY_EINZEL END AS EDM_FAKTOR_SOLL, /* ++++ FAKTOR AUF SOLL-MENGE = eigentliche P.Chargen-Menge ++++ */ EDMI.EDM_QTY_VERBRAUCHBAR / CASE WHEN (EDMI.EDM_QTY_EINZEL = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE EDMI.EDM_QTY_EINZEL END AS EDM_FAKTOR_VERBR /* ++++ FAKTOR AUF VERBRAUCHBAR-MENGE = eigentlich produzierbare P.Chargen-Menge ++++ */ FROM (SELECT EPS.EPS_EPSTKLISTID AS EDM_EPSTKLISTID, EPS.EPS_MENGE_FIXIERT AS EDM_EPS_FIXED, EPS.EPS_PCHARGENID AS EDM_PCHARGENID, EPS.EPS_ARL_FIRMENNR AS EDM_HAUPTFIRMENNR, EPS.EPS_ARL_ARTIKELNR AS EDM_ARL_ARTIKELNR, EPS.EPS_AID_ARTIKELIDLFDNR AS EDM_AID_ARTIKELIDLFDNR, ISNULL(EPS.EPS_VERFUEGBAR_KZ, 0) AS EDM_VERFUEGBAR_KZ, EPS.EPS_MENGE * SUM(DIS.DIS_GE_MENGE) / CASE WHEN (SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) END AS EDM_QTY_EINZEL, /* EinzelMenge * Faktor = Einzelmenge in SE */ EPS.EPS_SOLLMENGE * SUM(DIS.DIS_GE_MENGE) / CASE WHEN (SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) END AS EDM_QTY_SOLL, /* SollMenge * Faktor = SollMenge in SE */ CASE WHEN (EPS.EPS_VERFUEGBAR_KZ = 1) THEN EPS.EPS_SOLLMENGE * SUM(DIS.DIS_GE_MENGE) / CASE WHEN (SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) END /* SollMenge EPS (in SE) */ ELSE CASE WHEN (SUM(DIS.DIS_KALK_LAGERMENGE) < 0.0) THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(DIS.DIS_KALK_LAGERMENGE) END /* Dispo-KalkLagerMenge >= 0.0 max(kalk, 0) */ END AS EDM_QTY_VERBRAUCHBAR, /* Verbrauchbare, kalkulatorische LagerMenge in SE */ SUM( DIS.DIS_GE_MENGE )/ CASE WHEN (SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(DIS.DIS_DISPOMENGE) END AS EDM_FAKTOR_EPS_SE, /* Faktor von EPS(PE) auf SE */ DIS.DIS_GE_EINHEITKBEZ AS EDM_EINHEITKBEZ, MIN(DIS.DIS_DISPOTERMIN) AS EDM_DIS_TERMIN_MIN, COUNT(1) AS EDM_DIS_COUNT FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPS INNER JOIN WWS.DIS_DISPOLISTE DIS /* Berücksichtige nur EPS, die DISPO haben! */ ON (DIS.DIS_EPSTKLISTID = EPS.EPS_EPSTKLISTID) GROUP BY EPS.EPS_EPSTKLISTID, EPS.EPS_MENGE_FIXIERT, EPS.EPS_PCHARGENID, EPS.EPS_ARL_FIRMENNR, EPS.EPS_ARL_ARTIKELNR, EPS.EPS_AID_ARTIKELIDLFDNR, EPS.EPS_VERFUEGBAR_KZ, EPS.EPS_SOLLMENGE, EPS.EPS_MENGE, DIS.DIS_GE_EINHEITKBEZ ) EDMI )

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.PCC_VA_PCK_CRUMBS AS WITH PCK_PARENT_AP (PCK_HEAD_AP_ID, PCK_AP_CHILD_ID, PCK_HIERARCHIE, PCK_JOINT_BEZ, PCK_PSP, PCK_LEVEL) AS (SELECT C.PCK_AP_ID AS PCK_HEAD_AP_ID, C.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID, CASE WHEN A.APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AS_NR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_PSPOS,0), 5), ' ', '0') ELSE REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_PSPOS,0), 5), ' ', '0') END AS PCK_HIERARCHIE, CAST (CASE WHEN LEN(C.PCK_AG_BEZ) > 77 THEN SUBSTRING(C.PCK_AG_BEZ, 1, 77) + '..' ELSE C.PCK_AG_BEZ END AS VARCHAR (MAX)), CAST ( CASE WHEN A.APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN 'A' +LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AS_NR)) + 'L' + LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR)) ELSE ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_PSPOS)), 'L' + LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR))) END AS VARCHAR (MAX)) AS PCK_PSP, 1 AS PCK_LEVEL FROM PRODUKTION.PCK_PPS_KAPA C JOIN PRODUKTION.APA_ARBEITSPLAN A ON (C.PCK_AP_ID = A.APA_AP_ID) WHERE C.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT P.PCK_HEAD_AP_ID, C.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID, P.PCK_HIERARCHIE + '.' + CASE WHEN A.APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AS_NR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_PSPOS,0), 5), ' ', '0') ELSE REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR,0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(C.PCK_PSPOS,0), 5), ' ', '0') END AS PCK_HIERARCHIE, CAST (ISNULL(P.PCK_JOINT_BEZ,'') + '/' + CASE WHEN LEN(C.PCK_AG_BEZ) > 77 THEN SUBSTRING(C.PCK_AG_BEZ, 1, 77) + '..' ELSE C.PCK_AG_BEZ END AS VARCHAR (MAX)), CAST (ISNULL(P.PCK_PSP,'') +'.'+ CASE WHEN A.APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN 'A' +LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AS_NR)) + 'L' + LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR)) ELSE ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_PSPOS)), 'L' + LTRIM(STR(C.PCK_AG_LFDNR))) END AS VARCHAR (MAX)) AS PCK_PSP, P.PCK_LEVEL + 1 AS PCK_LEVEL FROM PCK_PARENT_AP P JOIN PRODUKTION.PCK_PPS_KAPA C ON (P.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID = C.PCK_AP_ID) JOIN PRODUKTION.APA_ARBEITSPLAN A ON (C.PCK_AP_ID = A.APA_AP_ID) WHERE C.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID IS NOT NULL ) SELECT PCK_HEAD_AP_ID AS PCC_HEAD_AP_ID, PCK_AP_CHILD_ID AS PCC_AP_CHILD_ID, PCK_HIERARCHIE AS PCC_HIERARCHIE, PCK_JOINT_BEZ AS PCC_JOINT_BEZ, PCK_PSP AS PCC_PSP, PCK_LEVEL AS PCC_LEVEL FROM PCK_PARENT_AP

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.PCS_VA_PCK_STARTBAR AS SELECT PCK.PCK_PPSKAPAID AS PCS_PCK_PPSKAPAID, CASE WHEN PCK.PCK_VERFA_KZ = 1 THEN CASE WHEN PCK.PCK_STATUS IS NULL OR PCK.PCK_STATUS < 2000 THEN 2 ELSE CASE WHEN (PCK.PCK_STATUS >=3000 AND PCK.PCK_STATUS <4000) THEN 7 ELSE CASE WHEN (PCK.PCK_STATUS >=2000 AND PCK.PCK_STATUS <3000) OR (PCK.PCK_STATUS >=4000 AND PCK.PCK_STATUS <6000) THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(AG1.PCK_STATUS), 6000) FROM PRODUKTION.AGL_ARBEITSGANGZU AGL JOIN PRODUKTION.PCK_PPS_KAPA AG1 ON (AG1.PCK_PPSKAPAID = AGL.AGL_AG_PARENT_ID) WHERE AGL.AGL_AG_ID = PCK.PCK_PPSKAPAID) >= 6000 THEN 4 ELSE 3 END ELSE 5 END END END ELSE 1 END AS PCS_PCK_STARTBAR FROM PRODUKTION.PCK_PPS_KAPA PCK

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.PF2_VIEW_PER_PRO_FWF_PROXY AS SELECT FWF_FIRMENNR as PFW_FIRMENNR, FWF_FIBUNR as PFW_FIBUNR, FWF_FIBUGUELTIGJAHR as PFW_FIBUGUELTIGJAHR, PER.PER_FIRMENNR as PFW_PER_FIRMENNR, PER.PER_PERSONENID as PFW_PERSONENID, PRO.PRO_PROJEKTID as PFW_PROJEKTID, datepart(year, FWF.FWF_WJBEGINN) as PFW_WJBEGINN_YEAR, datepart(month, FWF.FWF_WJBEGINN) as PFW_WJBEGINN_MONTH, datepart(year, FWF.FWF_WJENDE) as PFW_WJENDE_YEAR, datepart(month, FWF.FWF_WJENDE) as PFW_WJENDE_MONTH, RANK () over (Partition BY FWF_FIRMENNR, PRO_PROJEKTID, FWF_FIBUGUELTIGJAHR order by isnull(FWF_KLIENTENMONITORING, 0) desc, FWF_FIBUNR, PER_PERSONENID) AS PFW_R FROM FIBU.FWF_FIRMENWERTEFIBU FWF left join BUERO.PER_PERSON PER on PER.PER_ENTSPRICHT_FIRMENNR = FWF.FWF_FIRMENNR left join BUERO.PRO_PROJEKT PRO on FWF.FWF_PRO_PROJEKTTYP = PRO.PRO_PROJEKTTYP and FWF.FWF_PRO_FIRMENNR = PRO.PRO_FIRMENNR and FWF.FWF_PRO_PROJEKTNR = PRO.PRO_PROJEKTNR

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.PFW_VA_PCKFWF AS select PCK.PCK_PPSKAPAID as PFW_PPSKAPAID, COALESCE ( FWF.FWF_FIRMENNR, FWF2.FWF_FIRMENNR) as PFW_FIRMENNR, COALESCE ( FWF.FWF_FIBUNR, FWF2.FWF_FIBUNR) as PFW_FIBUNR, RANK () over (Partition BY PCK_PPSKAPAID order by COALESCE ( FWF.FWF_FIRMENNR, FWF2.FWF_FIRMENNR), COALESCE ( FWF.FWF_FIBUNR, FWF2.FWF_FIBUNR )) AS PFW_R from (SELECT PCK.PCK_PPSKAPAID, PCK_BEZUGSJAHR, PCK_BEZUGSMONAT + PCK_BEZUGSJAHR * 25 as PCK_BJM, isnull(PCK.PCK_PROJEKTID, 0) as PCK_PROJEKTID, PER.PER_ENTSPRICHT_FIRMENNR as PCK_ENTSPRICHT_FIRMENNR FROM PRODUKTION.PCK_PPS_KAPA PCK isnull(PRO_PROJEKTID, 0) as FWF_PROJEKTID, datepart(month, FWF.FWF_WJBEGINN) + datepart(year, FWF.FWF_WJBEGINN) * 25 as FWF_WJBEGINN_N, datepart(month, FWF.FWF_WJENDE) + datepart(year, FWF.FWF_WJENDE) = fwf.FWF_FIRMENNR and PCK_PROJEKTID = fwf.FWF_PROJEKTID and fwf.FWF_WJBEGINN_N <= PCK_BJM and PCK_BJM <= fwf.FWF_WJENDE_N and fwf.FWF_R = 1 left join (SELECT FWF_FIRMENNR, FWF_FIBUNR, FWF_FIBUGUELTIGJAHR, isnull(PRO_PROJEKTID, 0) as FWF_PROJEKTID, RANK () over (Partition BY FWF_FIRMENNR, FWF_FIBUGUELTIGJAHR, PRO_PROJEKTID order by isnull(FWF_KLIENTENMONITORING,1) desc, FWF_FIBUNR) AS FWF_R FROM FIBU.FWF_FIRMENWERTEFIBU FWF left join BUERO.PRO_PROJEKT PRO on FWF.FWF_PRO_PROJEKTTYP = PRO.PRO_PROJEKTTYP and FWF.FWF_PRO_FIRMENNR = PRO.PRO_FIRMENNR and FWF.FWF_PRO_PROJEKTNR = ELSE P.PCK_AG_BEZ END AS varchar(max)) + '/' + CAST(CASE WHEN LEN(C.PCK_AG_BEZ) > 77 THEN SUBSTRING(C.PCK_AG_BEZ, 1, 77) + '..' ELSE C.PCK_AG_BEZ END AS varchar(max)) AS C_BEZ, P.PCK_AP_ID AS P_APID, P.PCK_PPSKAPAID AS P_ID from produktion.pck_pps_kapa C join produktion.pck_pps_kapa P on C.PCK_AP_ID = P.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID join produktion.apa_arbeitsplan CA on P.pck_ap_id = CA.apa_ap_id join produktion.apa_arbeitsplan PA on P.pck_ap_id = PA.apa_ap_id UNION ALL select C.PHV_C_ID AS C_ID, C.PHV_C_LEVEL + 1 AS C_LEVEL, CASE WHEN APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(P.PCK_AS_NR, 0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(P.PCK_AG_LFDNR, 0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(P.PCK_PSPOS, 0), 5), ' ', '0') ELSE REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(P.PCK_AG_LFDNR, 0), 5), ' ', '0') + REPLACE(STR(ISNULL(P.PCK_PSPOS, 0), 5), ' ', '0') END + '.' + C.PHV_C_HIERARCHIE AS C_HIERARCHIE, CAST(CASE WHEN APA_STRUKTUR = 3 THEN 'A' + ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(P.PCK_AS_NR)),'') + 'L' + ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(P.PCK_AG_LFDNR)),'') ELSE ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(P.PCK_PSPOS)), 'L' + ISNULL(LTRIM(STR(P.PCK_AG_LFDNR)),'')) END AS varchar(max)) + '.' + C.PHV_C_PSP AS C_PSP, CAST(CASE WHEN LEN(P.PCK_AG_BEZ) > 77 THEN SUBSTRING(P.PCK_AG_BEZ, 1, 77) + '..' ELSE P.PCK_AG_BEZ END AS varchar(max)) + '/' + C.PHV_C_BEZ AS C_BEZ, P.PCK_AP_ID AS P_APID, P.PCK_PPSKAPAID AS P_ID from PARENT_PCK C join produktion.pck_pps_kapa P on C.PHV_P_APID = P.PCK_AP_CHILD_ID join produktion.apa_arbeitsplan on P.pck_ap_id = apa_ap_id ), PARENT_PCK_RANKED (PHV_C_ID, PHV_C_LEVEL, PHV_C_HIERARCHIE, PHV_C_PSP, PHV_C_BEZ, PHV_P_APID, PHV_P_ID, R) AS ( select PP.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PHV_C_ID ORDER BY PHV_C_LEVEL DESC) AS R FROM PARENT_PCK PP ) select PHV_C_ID, PHV_C_LEVEL, PHV_C_HIERARCHIE, PHV_C_PSP, PHV_C_BEZ, PHV_P_APID, PHV_P_ID from PARENT_PCK_RANKED where R = 1

CREATE VIEW "PRODUKTION"."PP7_VIEW_PRO_KULI_SALDEN" ("PP7_FIRMENNR", "PP7_FIBUNR", "PP7_KONTONR", "PP7_KONTENGRUPPE", "PP7_PERSONENID", "PP7_SOLL", "PP7_HABEN", "PP7_SALDO", "PP7_UMSATZ") AS SELECT KO.KTO_FIRMENNR AS PP7_FIRMENNR, KO.KTO_FIBUNR AS PP7_FIBUNR, KO.KTO_KONTONR AS PP7_KONTONR, KO.KTO_KONTENGRUPPE AS PP7_KONTENGRUPPE, P1.PEK_KLID AS PP7_PERSONENID, SA.SAD_SOLL AS PP7_SOLL, SA.SAD_HABEN AS PP7_HABEN, (SA.SAD_SOLL + SA.SAD_HABEN) AS PP7_SALDO, (SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ1 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ2 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ3 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ4 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ5 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ6 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ7 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ8 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ9 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ10 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ11 + SA.SAD_MONATSUMSATZ12) AS PP7_UMSATZ FROM ( ( ( ( ( BUERO.PER_PERSON PE RIGHT JOIN FIBU.PEK_PERSONENKONTO P1 ON ( PE.PER_FIRMENNR = P1.PEK_KLID_FIRMENNR ) AND ( PE.PER_PERSONENID = P1.PEK_KLID ) ) INNER JOIN FIBU.KTO_KONTO KO ON ( P1.PEK_FIRMENNR = KO.KTO_FIRMENNR ) AND ( P1.PEK_FIBUNR = KO.KTO_FIBUNR ) AND ( P1.PEK_KONTONR = KO.KTO_KONTONR ) ) INNER JOIN BUERO.FIR_FIRMA FI ON ( FI.FIR_FIRMENNR = KO.KTO_FIRMENNR ) AND ( FI.FIR_AKTUELLE_FIBU = KO.KTO_FIBUNR ) ) LEFT JOIN BUERO.KLI_KUNDE_LIEFERANT KL ON ( KL.KLI_FIRMENNR = P1.PEK_KLID_FIRMENNR ) AND ( KL.KLI_KLID = P1.PEK_KLID ) ) LEFT JOIN FIBU.SAD_SALDEN SA ON ( SA.SAD_FIRMENNR = P1.PEK_FIRMENNR ) AND ( SA.SAD_FIBUNR = P1.PEK_FIBUNR ) AND ( SA.SAD_KONTONR = P1.PEK_KONTONR ) ) WHERE SA.SAD_SALDEN_LFDNR = 0 AND SA.SAD_SALDEN_KZ = 0 AND (KO.KTO_KONTENGRUPPE = 2 OR KO.KTO_KONTENGRUPPE = 3 OR KO.KTO_KONTENGRUPPE = 4)

ISNULL( CASE WHEN(ERP.ERP_BESCH_ERFASSTEXTNR IS NOT NULL) THEN ERP.ERP_FIRMENNR /* ERT */ WHEN(ERP.ERP_BESCH_WWSTEXTBNR IS NOT NULL) THEN ERP.ERP_ARL_FIRMENNR /* WTB */ ELSE NULL END, CASE CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.VPV_VA_EPS_PLC_AVAILABLE AS (SELECT VPV_PCHARGENID, COUNT(1) AS VPV_EPS_ARL_COUNT, MIN(VPV_QTY_VERF_NORM) AS VPV_QTY_VERF_MIN_NORM, CASE WHEN (MIN(VPV_MULTIPLIER) > 1) THEN 1 ELSE MIN(VPV_MULTIPLIER) END AS VPV_MULTIPLIER_NORM /* Produzierbare C.Menge in ChargenEinheit! */ FROM (SELECT EDM.EDM_PCHARGENID AS VPV_PCHARGENID, EDM.EDM_EPS_FIXED, EDM.EDM_VERFUEGBAR_KZ, EDM.EDM_HAUPTFIRMENNR , EDM.EDM_ARL_ARTIKELNR , EDM.EDM_AID_ARTIKELIDLFDNR, /* Relevante Group-Keys */ CASE WHEN (EDM.EDM_VERFUEGBAR_KZ = 1) THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN (EDM.EDM_EPS_FIXED = 1) AND (SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_VERBR) / CASE WHEN (SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_SOLL) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_SOLL)) END < 1) THEN 0 ELSE SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_VERBR) / CASE WHEN (SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_SOLL) = 0.0) THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_SOLL)) END END END AS VPV_MULTIPLIER, /* Verbrauchbar-Faktor (zu):Soll-Faktor, wenn Verfügbarkeit <> 1 und alle fixierten Mengen >= 1! */ SUM(EDM.EDM_FAKTOR_VERBR) AS VPV_QTY_VERF_NORM /* Verbrauchbar-Faktor */ FROM PRODUKTION.EDM_VA_EPS_DIS_MENGEN EDM WHERE EDM.EDM_PCHARGENID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EDM.EDM_PCHARGENID, EDM.EDM_EPS_FIXED, EDM.EDM_VERFUEGBAR_KZ, EDM.EDM_HAUPTFIRMENNR, EDM.EDM_ARL_ARTIKELNR, EDM.EDM_AID_ARTIKELIDLFDNR ) VPV GROUP BY VPV_PCHARGENID )

CREATE VIEW PRODUKTION.VQT_VA_PLC_QTY_TAGGED AS ( SELECT PLC.PLC_PCHARGENID AS VQT_PCHARGENID, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_QTY ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_QTY_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_QTY_OFFEN ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_QTY_OFFEN_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_QTY_FERTIG ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_QTY_FERTIG_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_QTY_PCP ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_QTY_PCP_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_PQTY_A ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_PQTY_A_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_PQTY_V ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_PQTY_V_TAGGED, CASE WHEN (PLC.PLC_MARK = 1) THEN PLC.PLC_PQTY_M ELSE 0.0 END AS VQT_PQTY_M_TAGGED FROM PRODUKTION.PLC_PPS_CHARGE PLC )

CREATE VIEW QS.QMV_QMZ_TREE AS WITH cte ( qps_qpsid, qmz_parent_qpsid, qmz_root_qpsid, qmz_level, qmz_hierarchie, qmz_order ) AS ( SELECT qps.qps_qpsid, qps.qps_qpsid AS qmz_parent_qpsid, convert(varchar(max),qps.qps_qpsid) AS qmz_root_qpsid, 0 AS qmz_level, convert(varchar(max),qps.qps_qpsid) AS qmz_hierarchie, convert(varchar(max),qps.qps_qpsid) AS qmz_order FROM qs.qps_pruefplan_stamm qps UNION ALL SELECT qmz.qmz_unterg_qpsid AS qps_qpsid, qmz.qmz_qpsid AS qmz_parent_qpsid, cte.qmz_root_qpsid, cte.qmz_level + 1 AS qmz_level, cte.qmz_hierarchie + '.' + convert(varchar(max),qmz.qmz_unterg_qpsid), cte.qmz_order + '.'+ RIGHT('000000000'+convert(varchar(max),qmz.qmz_reihenfolge),10) FROM qs.qmz_qps_merkmal_zu qmz INNER JOIN cte ON cte.qps_qpsid = qmz.qmz_qpsid WHERE qmz.qmz_unterg_qpsid IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT qmz.*, qps.*, qst.*, cte.qmz_root_qpsid, cte.qmz_parent_qpsid, cte.qmz_level, cte.qmz_hierarchie, cte.qmz_order FROM cte INNER JOIN qs.qps_pruefplan_stamm qps ON cte.qps_qpsid = qps.qps_qpsid LEFT JOIN qs.qmz_qps_merkmal_zu qmz ON qmz.qmz_qpsid = cte.qmz_parent_qpsid AND qmz.qmz_unterg_qpsid = cte.qps_qpsid LEFT JOIN produktion.qst_qm_stamm qst ON qst.qst_firmennr = qmz.qmz_qst_firmennr AND qst.qst_qm_nr = qmz.qmz_qst_qm_nr UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT qmz.*, qps.*, qst.*, cte.qmz_root_qpsid, cte.qmz_parent_qpsid, cte.qmz_level + 1 AS qmz_level, cte.qmz_hierarchie + '.' + convert(varchar(max),qmz.qmz_qmzid) AS qmz_hierarchie, cte.qmz_order + '.' + RIGHT('000000000'+convert(varchar(max),qmz.qmz_reihenfolge),10) as qmz_order FROM cte INNER JOIN qs.qps_pruefplan_stamm qps ON cte.qps_qpsid = qps.qps_qpsid INNER JOIN qs.qmz_qps_merkmal_zu qmz ON qmz.qmz_qpsid = cte.qps_qpsid AND qmz.qmz_unterg_qpsid IS NULL INNER JOIN produktion.qst_qm_stamm qst ON qst.qst_firmennr = qmz.qmz_qst_firmennr AND qst.qst_qm_nr = qmz.qmz_qst_qm_nr

CREATE VIEW WWS.AGD_VIEW_AG_PERSON_DHECK AS SELECT AGN.AGN_AG_ID AS AGD_AG_ID, COUNT(1) AS AGD_POSITIONS, COUNT(CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 OR AGN_PER_PERSONENID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 1 END) AS AGD_VALID, COUNT(CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGD_DELETED, COUNT(CASE WHEN (AGN_LOESCHEN IS NULL OR AGN_LOESCHEN = 0) AND AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGD_OPTIONAL, COUNT(CASE WHEN (AGN_LOESCHEN IS NULL OR AGN_LOESCHEN = 0) AND (AGN_VORMERKEN IS NULL OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 0) AND AGN_PER_PERSONENID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AGD_MISSING, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_DAUER END) AS AGD_SOLL_DAUER, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_DAUER END) AS AGD_V_SOLL_DAUER, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_KOSTEN END) AS AGD_SOLL_KOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_KOSTEN END) AS AGD_V_SOLL_KOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN END) AS AGD_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN END) AS AGD_V_SOLL_VOLLKOSTEN, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_ERLOES END) AS AGD_SOLL_ERLOES, SUM (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN 0 ELSE AGN_SOLL_ERLOES END) AS AGD_V_SOLL_ERLOES, MIN (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGN_STATUS END) AS AGD_MIN_STATUS, MIN (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGN_STATUS END) AS AGD_V_MIN_STATUS, MAX (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 OR AGN_VORMERKEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGN_STATUS END) AS AGD_MAX_STATUS, MAX (CASE WHEN AGN_LOESCHEN = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AGN_STATUS END) AS AGD_V_MAX_STATUS, MIN(AGN_SOLL_START) AS AGD_MIN_SOLL_START, MAX(AGN_SOLL_ENDE) AS AGD_MAX_SOLL_ENDE FROM WWS.AGN_AG_PERSON_ZU AGN GROUP BY AGN.AGN_AG_ID

VEC_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, VEC_VERBUCHTSTATUS) AS ( SELECT WAX.WAP_BPD_FIRMENNR, WAX.WAP_BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ, WAX.WAP_BPD_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR, WAX.WAP_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR, WAX.WAP_BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR, WAX.VEC_WEU_MENGE, WAX.VEC_ERB_MENGE, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(WAX.VEC_WEU_MENGE,0) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT*/ WHEN ISNULL(WAX.VEC_WEU_MENGE,0) = ISNULL(BPD.BPD_MENGE,0) THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VEC_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(WAX.VEC_ERB_MENGE,0) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT*/ WHEN ISNULL(WAX.VEC_ERB_MENGE,0) = ISNULL(BPD.BPD_MENGE,0) THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VEC_VERBUCHTSTATUS FROM (SELECT WAP.WAP_BPD_FIRMENNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ, WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR, SUM(WEU.WEU_MENGE) AS VEC_WEU_MENGE, SUM(CASE WHEN ERB_BUCHUNGSTATUS = 9 THEN WEU.WEU_MENGE ELSE 0 END) AS VEC_ERB_MENGE FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAP INNER JOIN WWS.WEU_WWSERKONTROLLEZU WEU ON (WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR) INNER JOIN WWS.WER_WWSERKONTROLLEKOPF WER ON (WER.WER_ERKONTRKOPF_ID = WEU.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) INNER JOIN FIBU.ERB_BUCHUNG ERB ON (ERB.ERB_FIRMENNR = WER.WER_FIRMENNR AND ERB.ERB_FIBUNR = WER.WER_FIBUNR AND ERB.ERB_ERFASSNR = WER.WER_ERFASSNR) WHERE ISNULL(WEU.WEU_EINGANGSRECHNUNGSART,0) = 0 GROUP BY WAP.WAP_BPD_FIRMENNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ, WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR, WAP.WAP_BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR) WAX AND WAX.WAP_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR = BPD.BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR AND WAX.WAP_BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR = BPD.BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR) )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VEE_VA_ERFKOPFPOSWERTE ( VEE_FIRMENNR, VEE_ERFASSUNGSKZ, VEE_ERFASSUNGSNR, VEE_EINHEITKBEZ, VEE_AUFTRAGSMENGE, VEE_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ, VEE_GEWICHT, /*Nettogewicht altes Feld*/ VEE_VERPACKUNGSGEWICHT, VEE_BRUTTOGEWICHT, VEE_ANZAHL ) AS ( SELECT ERP.ERP_FIRMENNR, ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSNR, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN MAX(ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ ) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_EINHEITKBEZ, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN SUM(ERP.ERP_AUFTRAGSMENGE ) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_AUFTRAGSMENGE, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN MAX(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN SUM(ERP.ERP_POSGEWICHT) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_EINZEL_GEWICHT, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN SUM((ERP.ERP_EINZELVERP_GEWICHT * ERP.ERP_AUFTRAGSMENGE * ERP.ERP_EINHEITENFAKTOR)) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_EINZELVERP_GEWICHT, (CASE WHEN MIN(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) = MAX(ERP.ERP_GEWICHTS_EINHEITKBEZ) THEN SUM(ISNULL(ERP.ERP_EINZELVERP_GEWICHT * ERP.ERP_AUFTRAGSMENGE * ERP.ERP_EINHEITENFAKTOR,0)+ISNULL(ERP.ERP_POSGEWICHT,0)) ELSE NULL END) AS ERP_BRUTTOGEWICHT, COUNT(*) AS VEE_ANZAHL FROM WWS.ERP_ERFASSPOSITIONEN ERP GROUP BY ERP.ERP_FIRMENNR, ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VEO_VIEW_ERFASSPOSORIGSUM ( VEO_FIRMENNR, VEO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, VEO_ERFASSUNGSNR, VEO_VERKWERTPOSRAB, VEO_VERKWERTRAB ) AS ( SELECT ERO.ERO_FIRMENNR, ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR, SUM(CASE /* KEIN WÄHRUNGSKURS ODER KURSFAKTOR -> ANNAHME DASS IN STAMMWÄHRUNG */ WHEN ((ISNULL(EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURS, 0) <= 0) OR (ISNULL(EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURSFAKTOR, 0) <= 0)) THEN ISNULL(ERO.ERO_VERKWERTPOSRAB, 0) ELSE ROUND(((ISNULL(ERO.ERO_VERKWERTPOSRAB, 0) * EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURS) / EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURSFAKTOR), 2) END) AS ERO_VERKWERTPOSRAB, SUM(CASE /* KEIN WÄHRUNGSKURS ODER KURSFAKTOR -> ANNAHME DASS IN STAMMWÄHRUNG */ WHEN ((ISNULL(EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURS, 0) <= 0) OR (ISNULL(EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURSFAKTOR, 0) <= 0)) THEN ISNULL(ERO.ERO_VERKWERTRAB, 0) ELSE ROUND(((ISNULL(ERO.ERO_VERKWERTRAB, 0) * EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURS) / EFK.EFK_WAEHRUNGSKURSFAKTOR), 2) END) AS ERO_VERKWERTRAB FROM WWS.ERO_ERFASSPOSORIG ERO, WWS.EFK_ERFASSKOPFWWS EFK WHERE ERO.ERO_FIRMENNR = EFK.EFK_FIRMENNR AND ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ = EFK.EFK_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR = EFK.EFK_ERFASSUNGSNR GROUP BY ERO.ERO_FIRMENNR, ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VEW_VIEW_ERFASSKOPFWERTE (/* KEY */ VEW_FIRMENNR, VEW_ERFASSUNGSKZ, VEW_ERFASSUNGSNR, /* SOLL-WERTE */ VEW_RNP_VERKWERTRAB, VEW_RNP_EINSTWERT, VEW_RNP_DBWERT, VEW_RNP_DBPROZ, /* IST-WERTE */ VEW_LAGEREINSTWERT, VEW_LAGER_DBWERT, VEW_LAGER_DBPROZ, /* STAT-WERTE */ VEW_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT, VEW_STATISTIK_DBWERT, VEW_STATISTIK_DBPROZ, /* DBABW */ VEW_DBABWPROZ_STAT_SOLL, VEW_DBABWPROZ_IST_SOLL, /* EFFAUF */ VEW_RNP_EFFAUFPROZ, VEW_STATISTIK_EFFAUFPROZ, VEW_LAGER_EFFAUFPROZ, VEW_RNP_VERKWERTPOSRAB) AS (SELECT /* KEY */ RNP.RNP_FIRMENNR, RNP.RNP_ERFASSUNGSKZ, RNP.RNP_ERFASSUNGSNR, /* SOLL-WERTE */ SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS), SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT), SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT), /* VOW_RNP_DBWERT */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /*VOW_RNP_DPROZ */ /* IST-WERTE */ SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)), SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)), (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /* STAT-WERTE */ SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) AS RNP_SUMSTATWERT, SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT), (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /* DBABW */ (CASE WHEN (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) / (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 - 100 END), /* VOW_DBABWPROZ_STAT_SOLL */ (CASE WHEN (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) / (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 - 100 END), /* VOW_DBABWPROZ_IST_SOLL */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT) END), /*VOW_RNP_EFFAUFPROZ */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) END), /*VOW_STATISTIK_EFFAUFPROZ */ (CASE WHEN SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) * 100 / SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) END), /*VOW_LAGER_EFFAUFPROZ */ SUM(RNP.RNP_VKWERTPRABBASIS) FROM (SELECT RNX.*, (RNX.RNP_VERKWERTRAB * (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) WHEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) END) / (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR, 1) WHEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR,1) END)) AS RNP_VERKWERTBASIS, (RNX.RNP_VERKWERTPOSRAB * (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) WHEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) END) / (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR, 1) WHEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR,1) END)) AS RNP_VKWERTPRABBASIS FROM WWS.RNP_RECHNUNGSPOS RNX, WWS.RNG_RECHNUNG RNG WHERE RNG.RNG_FIRMENNR = RNX.RNP_FIRMENNR AND RNG.RNG_RECHNUNGLFDNR = RNX.RNP_RECHNUNGLFDNR AND RNG.RNG_ISTVERSPEICHERT = 1 ) RNP GROUP BY RNP.RNP_FIRMENNR, RNP.RNP_ERFASSUNGSKZ, RNP.RNP_ERFASSUNGSNR)

CREATE VIEW WWS.VEZ_VIEW_WWSERKZU_SUM (VEZ_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, VEZ_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VEZ_MENGE, VEZ_HASSPERRE) AS ( SELECT WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, (CASE WHEN MAX(WEU_SATZKZ) IN (1,2) THEN MAX(WEU_MENGE) ELSE SUM(WEU_MENGE) END) AS WEU_SUMMENGE, MAX(CASE WHEN WEU_SATZKZ IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WEU_HASSPERRE FROM WWS.WEU_WWSERKONTROLLEZU WEU WHERE ISNULL(WEU_EINGANGSRECHNUNGSART,0) = 0 GROUP BY WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VID_VA_DIS_INVALID AS SELECT DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR AS VID_FIRMENNR, DIS.DIS_DISPOLFDNR AS VID_DISPOLFDNR FROM WWS.DIS_DISPOLISTE DIS WHERE DIS.DIS_LUAID IS NULL AND /* Alle ERO-Dispos wo Fertigkz = 1,2 und keine ProduktionsCharge */ (DIS.DIS_PCHARGENID IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WWS.ERO_ERFASSPOSORIG ERO WHERE DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR = ERO.ERO_FIRMENNR AND DIS.DIS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ = ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND DIS.DIS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR = ERO.ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR AND DIS.DIS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = ERO.ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR AND DIS.DIS_ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR = ERO.ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR AND ERO.ERO_FERTIGKZ IN (1, 2)) OR /* Alle BPD-Dispos wo Fertigkz = 1,2 und keine ProduktionsCharge */ (DIS.DIS_PCHARGENID IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WWS.BPD_BESTPOSDETAIL BPD WHERE DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR = BPD.BPD_FIRMENNR AND DIS.DIS_BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ = BPD.BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND DIS.DIS_BPD_BESTPRODERFASSNR = BPD.BPD_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR AND DIS.DIS_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR = BPD.BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR AND DIS.DIS_BPD_ERFASSPOSDETLFDNR = BPD.BPD_ERFASSPOSDETAILLFDNR AND BPD.BPD_FERTIGKZ IN (1, 2)) ) OR /* Alle LPO-Dispos welche Verspeichert sind */ (DIS.DIS_DISPOKZ = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WWS.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOS LPO WHERE LPO.LPO_FIRMENNR = DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR AND LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINLFDNR = DIS.DIS_LIEFERSCHEINLFDNR AND LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOSLFDNR = DIS.DIS_LIEFERSCHEINPOSLFDNR AND LPO.LPO_ISTVERSPEICHERT = 1)) OR /* Unbekannt PPS */ ( DIS.DIS_EPSTKLISTID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPS WHERE DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR = EPS.EPS_FIRMENNR AND DIS.DIS_EPSTKLISTID = EPS.EPS_EPSTKLISTID AND EPS.EPS_LAGERKZ > 0)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUKTION.KOP_KOMMISSIONIERUNG_POS KOP, fertiggemeldeten PLC, die gelöscht sein müssten */ SELECT DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR AS VID_FIRMENNR, DIS.DIS_DISPOLFDNR AS VID_DISPOLFDNR FROM WWS.DIS_DISPOLISTE DIS INNER JOIN PRODUKTION.PLC_PPS_CHARGE PLC ON (DIS.DIS_PCHARGENID = PLC.PLC_PCHARGENID) WHERE DIS.DIS_LUAID IS NULL AND DIS.DIS_WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID IS NULL AND DIS.DIS_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR IS NULL AND PLC.PLC_STATUS = 20 /*20=fertig*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUKTION.KOP_KOMMISSIONIERUNG_POS KOP, PRODUKTION.KOK_KOMMISSIONIERUNG_KOPF KOK WHERE KOK.KOK_FIRMENNR = DIS.DIS_FIRMENNR AND KOK.KOK_KENNZEICHEN = 4 AND KOP.KOP_KOMID = RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) / SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) * MAX(RNP.RUECK_LAGERPREISPER) END), /*VOW_LAGERPREIS */ (CASE SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) WHEN NULL THEN NULL WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(RNP.RUECK_F_LAGEREW) / SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) * MAX(RNP.RUECK_LAGERPREISPER) END), /*VOW_F_LAGERPREIS */ MAX(RNP.RUECK_LAGERPREISPER), /* VOW_LAGERPREISPER */ SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) AS RNP_SUMSTATWERT, /* VOW_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT */ SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_F_EINSTWERT) AS RNP_SUMFSTATWERT, /* VOW_STATISTIK_F_EINSTWERT */ (CASE SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) WHEN NULL THEN NULL WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT, 0)) / SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) * MAX(RNP.RUECK_LAGERPREISPER) END), /* VOW_STATISTIK_EINSTPREIS */ (CASE SUM(RNP.RNP_MENGE) WHEN NULL THEN NULL WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)), (CASE WHEN CREATE VIEW WWS.VRW_VIEW_RECHNUNGSWERTE (/* KEY */ VRW_FIRMENNR, VRW_RECHNUNGLFDNR, /* SOLL-WERTE */ VRW_RNP_VERKWERTRAB, VRW_RNP_EINSTWERT, VRW_RNP_DBWERT, VRW_RNP_DBPROZ, /* IST-WERTE */ VRW_LAGEREINSTWERT, VRW_LAGER_DBWERT, VRW_LAGER_DBPROZ, /* STAT-WERTE */ VRW_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT, VRW_STATISTIK_DBWERT, VRW_STATISTIK_DBPROZ, /* DBABW */ VRW_DBABWPROZ_STAT_SOLL, VRW_DBABWPROZ_IST_SOLL, /* EFFAUF */ VRW_RNP_EFFAUFPROZ, VRW_STATISTIK_EFFAUFPROZ, VRW_LAGER_EFFAUFPROZ, VRW_RNP_VERKWERTPOSRAB) AS (SELECT /* KEY */ RNP.RNP_FIRMENNR, RNP.RNP_RECHNUNGLFDNR, /* SOLL-WERTE */ SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS), SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT), SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT), /* VOW_RNP_DBWERT */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /*VOW_RNP_DPROZ */ /* IST-WERTE */ SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)), SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)), (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /* STAT-WERTE */ SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) AS RNP_SUMSTATWERT, SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT), (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) END), /* DBABW */ (CASE WHEN (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) / (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 - 100 END), /* VOW_DBABWPROZ_STAT_SOLL */ (CASE WHEN (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) / (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 - 100 END), /* VOW_DBABWPROZ_IST_SOLL */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT) END), /*VOW_RNP_EFFAUFPROZ */ (CASE WHEN SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT)) * 100 / SUM(RNP.RNP_STATISTIK_EINSTWERT) END), /*VOW_STATISTIK_EFFAUFPROZ */ (CASE WHEN SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(RNP.RNP_VERKWERTBASIS) - SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT))) * 100 / SUM(ISNULL(RNP.RNP_LAGEREINSTWERT, RNP.RNP_EINSTANDSWERT)) END), /*VOW_LAGER_EFFAUFPROZ */ SUM(RNP.RNP_VKWERTPRABBASIS) FROM (SELECT RNX.*, (RNX.RNP_VERKWERTRAB * (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) WHEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) END) / (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR, 1) WHEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR,1) END)) AS RNP_VERKWERTBASIS, (RNX.RNP_VERKWERTPOSRAB * (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) WHEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS = 0 THEN RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_WAEHRUNGSKURS,1) END) / (CASE WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 AND RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN 1 WHEN RNG.RNG_SAMMELRNGDATA_ONPOS = 1 THEN ISNULL(RNX.RNP_KURSFAKTOR, 1) WHEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR = 0 THEN RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR ELSE ISNULL(RNG.RNG_KURSFAKTOR,1) END)) AS RNP_VKWERTPRABBASIS FROM WWS.RNP_RECHNUNGSPOS RNX, WWS.RNG_RECHNUNG RNG WHERE RNG.RNG_FIRMENNR = RNX.RNP_FIRMENNR AND RNG.RNG_RECHNUNGLFDNR = RNX.RNP_RECHNUNGLFDNR AND RNG.RNG_ISTVERSPEICHERT = 1 ) RNP GROUP BY RNP.RNP_FIRMENNR, RNP.RNP_RECHNUNGLFDNR)

V.EPS_VOLLGELIEFERT, V.EPS_VOLLVERRECHNET, V.EPS_SETGELIEFERT, V.EPS_SETVERRECHNET, ELV.ELV_ZLMENGE FROM (SELECT EPSS0.EPS_FIRMENNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR, MIN(EPSS0.EPS_VOLLGELIEFERT) AS EPS_VOLLGELIEFERT, MIN(EPSS0.EPS_VOLLVERRECHNET) AS EPS_VOLLVERRECHNET, MIN(EPSS0.EPS_SETGELIEFERT) AS EPS_SETGELIEFERT, MIN(EPSS0.EPS_SETVERRECHNET) AS EPS_SETVERRECHNET FROM (SELECT EPSSZ.EPS_FIRMENNR, EPSSZ.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, EPSSZ.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR, EPSSZ.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR , EPSSZ.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR , EPSSZ.EPS_EPSTKLISTID, EPSSZ.EPS_SOLLMENGE AS EPSSOLL, (CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_GELIEFERT,0) AS EPS_GELIEFERT, (CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_VERRECHMENGE,0) AS EPS_VERRECHMENGE, (CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN 0 WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN 0 ELSE EPSSZ.EPS_SOLLMENGE END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_SOLLMENGE,0) AS EPS_SOLLMENGE, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE,0) > ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_MENGE,0) AND ISNULL(EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE,0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE,0) ELSE ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_MENGE,0) END) AS EPS_MENGE, (CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE <> 0 THEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_GELIEFERT,0)) / EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE WHEN EPSS1.EPS_MENGE <> 0 THEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_GELIEFERT,0)) / EPSS1.EPS_MENGE ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_SETGELIEFERT, (CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE <> 0 THEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_VERRECHMENGE,0)) / EPSSZ.EPS_MENGE WHEN EPSS1.EPS_MENGE <> 0 THEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_VERRECHMENGE,0)) / EPSS1.EPS_MENGE ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_SETVERRECHNET, (CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_GELIEFERT,0)) = ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN 0 WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN 0 ELSE EPSSZ.EPS_SOLLMENGE END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_SOLLMENGE,0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_VOLLGELIEFERT, (CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSZ.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_VERRECHMENGE,0)) = ((CASE WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN 0 WHEN EPSSZ.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN 0 ELSE EPSSZ.EPS_SOLLMENGE END) + ISNULL(EPSS1.EPS_SOLLMENGE,0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_VOLLVERRECHNET FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPSSZ LEFT JOIN (SELECT EPSSX.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID, SUM((CASE WHEN EPSSX.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSX.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSX.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSX.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS2.EPS_GELIEFERT,0)) AS EPS_GELIEFERT, SUM((CASE WHEN EPSSX.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSX.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) + ISNULL(EPSS2.EPS_VERRECHMENGE,0)) AS EPS_VERRECHMENGE, SUM((CASE WHEN EPSSX.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN 0 WHEN EPSSX.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN 0 ELSE EPSSX.EPS_SOLLMENGE END) + ISNULL(EPSS2.EPS_SOLLMENGE,0)) AS EPS_SOLLMENGE, MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(EPSSX.EPS_MENGE,0) > ISNULL(EPSS2.EPS_MENGE,0) AND ISNULL(EPSSX.EPS_MENGE,0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(EPSSX.EPS_MENGE,0) ELSE ISNULL(EPSS2.EPS_MENGE,0) END) AS EPS_MENGE FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPSSX LEFT JOIN (SELECT EPSSY.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID, SUM(CASE WHEN EPSSY.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN EPSSY.EPS_ISTMENGE WHEN EPSSY.EPS_LAGERKZ = 1 THEN EPSSY.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_GELIEFERT, SUM(CASE WHEN EPSSY.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN EPSSY.EPS_ISTMENGE ELSE 0 END) AS EPS_VERRECHMENGE, SUM(CASE WHEN EPSSY.EPS_LAGERKZ = 9 THEN 0 WHEN EPSSY.EPS_LAGERKZ = 8 THEN 0 ELSE EPSSY.EPS_SOLLMENGE END) AS EPS_SOLLMENGE, MAX(EPSSY.EPS_MENGE) AS EPS_MENGE FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPSSY WHERE EPSSY.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID IS NOT NULL AND EPSSY.EPS_EPSTKLISTPOSTYP = 4 GROUP BY EPSSY.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID) EPSS2 ON (EPSSX.EPS_EPSTKLISTID = EPSS2.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID) WHERE EPSSX.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID IS NOT NULL AND EPSSX.EPS_EPSTKLISTPOSTYP = 4 GROUP BY EPSSX.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID) EPSS1 ON (EPSSZ.EPS_EPSTKLISTID = EPSS1.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID) WHERE EPSSZ.EPS_URSPRUNG_EPSTKLISTID IS NULL AND EPSSZ.EPS_EPSTKLISTPOSTYP = 4 AND ISNULL(EPSSZ.EPS_MAT_BEISTELLUNGSKZ,-1) <> 0 ) EPSS0 GROUP BY EPSS0.EPS_FIRMENNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR, EPSS0.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR) V LEFT JOIN (SELECT ELVA.ELV_FIRMENNR, ELVA.ELV_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ELVA.ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR, ELVA.ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR, ELVA.ELV_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR, SUM(ELVA.ELV_ZLMENGE) AS ELV_ZLMENGE FROM WWS.ELV_ERFASSPOSLIEFERVOR ELVA WHERE ELVA.ELV_FREIGABEKZ > 0 AND ELVA.ELV_EPS_EPSTKLISTID IS NULL GROUP BY ELVA.ELV_FIRMENNR, CREATE VIEW WWS.VTI_VA_TRANSPORTENHINFO ( VTI_TRANSPORTEINHEITID, VTI_NETTOGEWICHT, VTI_TARA, VTI_BRUTTOGEWICHT ) AS (SELECT TRE.TRE_TRANSPORTEINHEITID, TRX.NETTO, TRE.TRE_TARA, (CASE WHEN TRE.TRE_TARA IS NULL THEN TRX.NETTO WHEN TRX.NETTO IS NULL THEN TRE.TRE_TARA ELSE TRX.NETTO + TRE.TRE_TARA END) AS BRUTTO FROM WWS.TRE_TRANSPORTEINHEIT TRE LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRP_TRANSPORTEINHEITID, SUM(CASE WHEN ELV_ERFASSPOSLVLFDNR IS NOT NULL THEN ELV.ELV_POSITIONSGEWICHT ELSE LPO.LPO_POSITIONSGEWICHT END) AS NETTO FROM WWS.TRP_TRANSPORTPOSITION TRP LEFT JOIN WWS.ELV_ERFASSPOSLIEFERVOR ELV ON (ELV.ELV_FIRMENNR = TRP_LIEFER_FIRMENNR AND ELV.ELV_ERFASSUNGSKZ = TRP.TRP_ELV_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND ELV.ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR = TRP.TRP_ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR AND ELV.ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = TRP.TRP_ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR AND ELV.ELV_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR = TRP.TRP_ELV_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR AND ELV.ELV_ERFASSPOSLVLFDNR = TRP.TRP_ELV_ERFASSPOSLVLFDNR) LEFT JOIN WWS.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOS LPO ON (LPO.LPO_FIRMENNR = TRP.TRP_LIEFER_FIRMENNR AND LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINLFDNR = TRP.TRP_LPO_LIEFERSCHEINLFDNR AND LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOSLFDNR = TRP.TRP_LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOSLFDNR AND TRP.TRP_EPS_EPSTKLISTID IS NULL AND TRP.TRP_KOP_KOMID IS NULL) GROUP BY TRP.TRP_TRANSPORTEINHEITID) TRX ON (TRX.TRP_TRANSPORTEINHEITID = TRE.TRE_TRANSPORTEINHEITID) )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VUA_VA_AUFANG_VERGLEICH ( VUA_AUF_FIRMENNR, VUA_AUF_ERFASSUNGSKZ, VUA_AUF_ERFASSUNGSNR, VUA_ANG_FIRMENNR, VUA_ANG_ERFASSUNGSKZ, VUA_ANG_ERFASSUNGSNR, VUA_AUF_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, VUA_ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, VUA_DIFF_WERT, VUA_DIFF_PROZ) AS WITH ANGEBOTVERGLEICH AS ( SELECT AUF.EFK_FIRMENNR AS AUF_FIRMENNR, AUF.EFK_ERFASSUNGSKZ AS AUF_ERFASSUNGSKZ, AUF.EFK_ERFASSUNGSNR AS AUF_ERFASSUNGSNR, ANG.EFK_FIRMENNR AS ANG_FIRMENNR, ANG.EFK_ERFASSUNGSKZ AS ANG_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ANG.EFK_ERFASSUNGSNR AS ANG_ERFASSUNGSNR, AUF.EFK_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO AS AUF_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, ANG.EFK_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO AS ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AUF.EFK_FIRMENNR, AUF.EFK_ERFASSUNGSKZ, AUF.EFK_ERFASSUNGSNR ORDER BY ANG.EFK_ERFASSUNGSDATUM DESC, ANG.EFK_ERFASSUNGSNR DESC) AS SORTLFDNR FROM WWS.EFK_ERFASSKOPFWWS AUF INNER JOIN WWS.EFK_ERFASSKOPFWWS ANG ON (AUF.EFK_VON_ANGEB_FIRMENNR = ANG.EFK_ORGANGEB_FIRMENNR AND AUF.EFK_VON_ANGEB_ERFASSUNGSKZ = ANG.EFK_ORGANGEB_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND AUF.EFK_VON_ANGEB_ERFASSUNGSNR = ANG.EFK_ORGANGEB_ERFASSUNGSNR AND ANG.EFK_ERFASSUNGSART = 'ANG' ) ) SELECT AUF_FIRMENNR, AUF_ERFASSUNGSKZ, AUF_ERFASSUNGSNR, ANG_FIRMENNR, ANG_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ANG_ERFASSUNGSNR, AUF_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO, (AUF_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO - ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO) AS DIFF_WERT, (CASE WHEN ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (AUF_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO - ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO) / ANG_VERKAUFSWERT_NETTO * 100 END) AS DIFF_PROZ FROM ANGEBOTVERGLEICH WHERE SORTLFDNR = 1

CREATE VIEW WWS.VVE_VA_EPS_AUFTRAGSKEYS AS (SELECT EPS.EPS_EPSTKLISTID as VVE_EPSTKLISTID, EPS.EPS_ERO_FIRMENNR as VVE_FIRMENNR, EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ as VVE_ERFASSUNGSKZ, ISNULL(EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR, EPS.EPS_BPD_BESTPRODERFNR) as VVE_ERFASSUNGSNR, ISNULL(EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR, EPS.EPS_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR) as VVE_ERFASSPOSLFDNR, ISNULL(EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR, EPS.EPS_BPD_ERFPOSDETAILLFDNR) AS VVE_ERFPOSDETAILLFDNR, ISNULL(ERP.ERP_POSITIONSNR, BPP.BPP_POSITIONSNR) AS VVE_POSITIONSNR FROM WWS.EPS_ERFASSPOS_STUECKLISTE EPS left join WWS.ERP_ERFASSPOSITIONEN ERP on (EPS.EPS_ERO_FIRMENNR = ERP.ERP_FIRMENNR AND EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ = ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSNR = ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSNR AND EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = ERP.ERP_ERFASSPOSLFDNR) left join WWS.BPP_BESTPOSITION BPP on (EPS.EPS_ERO_FIRMENNR = BPP.BPP_FIRMENNR AND EPS.EPS_ERO_ERFASSUNGSKZ = BPP.BPP_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND EPS.EPS_BPD_BESTPRODERFNR = BPP.BPP_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR AND EPS.EPS_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR = BPP.BPP_BESTPOSLFDNR) )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VVW_VA_WEINSATZVERLEIHSUM ( VVW_WEINSATZKOPFID, VVW_LIEFERUNG_VLJID, VVW_ZEITEINHEITEN, VVW_MENGE_GES, VVW_WERT ) AS ( SELECT WVD_WEINSATZKOPFID, WVD_LIEFERUNG_VLJID, SUM(WVD_ZEITEINHEITEN), SUM(WVD_MENGE_GES), SUM(WVD_WERT) FROM WWS.WVD_WEINSATZVERLEIHDAT WVD GROUP BY WVD_WEINSATZKOPFID, WVD_LIEFERUNG_VLJID )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWB_VIEW_WARENEINGBUCHSUM (VWB_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWB_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VWB_EINGANGSWERT_OFFEN, VWB_FRACHTWERT_OFFEN, VWB_WEBUCHWERT_GESAMT ) AS ( SELECT WAB.WAB_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAB.WAB_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(WAB.WAB_BUCHART,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(WAB.WAB_ISTSTORNIERT, 0) = 0 THEN WAB.WAB_WARENEINGBUCHBETRAG ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(WAB.WAB_BUCHART,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(WAB.WAB_ISTSTORNIERT, 0) = 0 THEN WAB.WAB_WARENEINGBUCHBETRAG ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(WAB.WAB_BUCHKENNZ,0)=0 AND ISNULL(WAB.WAB_ISTKORRIGIERT,0)=0 THEN WAB.WAB_WARENEINGBUCHBETRAG ELSE 0 END) FROM WWS.WAB_WARENEINGANGBUCH WAB GROUP BY WAB.WAB_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAB.WAB_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWD_VA_WEINGPOS_DOKINFO ( VWD_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWD_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VWD_DOKINFO ) AS ( SELECT EDZ.EDZ_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, EDZ.EDZ_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, 1 FROM WWS.EDZ_ERFASSDOKUMENTZU EDZ WHERE EDZ.EDZ_AUFT_BEST_KZ = 2 GROUP BY EDZ.EDZ_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, EDZ.EDZ_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWE_VIEW_WWSERKOPFINFO (VWE_FIRMENNR, VWE_FIBUNR, VWE_ERFASSNR, VWE_EXISTS_ZUORDNUNG, VWE_NETTOWERT ) AS ( SELECT WER.WER_FIRMENNR, WER.WER_FIBUNR, WER.WER_ERFASSNR, MAX(WEUS.WEU_ZUORDNUNG) AS VWE_EXISTS_ZUORDNUNG, SUM(WEPS.WEPS_NETTOWERT) AS NETTOWERT FROM (WWS.WER_WWSERKONTROLLEKOPF WER LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEU.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID, 1 AS WEU_ZUORDNUNG FROM WWS.WEU_WWSERKONTROLLEZU WEU GROUP BY WEU.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) WEUS ON (WEUS.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID = WER.WER_ERKONTRKOPF_ID)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEP.WEP_ERKONTRKOPF_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(WEP.WEP_EINGANGSRECHNUNGSART,0) = 0 THEN WEP.WEP_EINKAUFSWERT ELSE WEP.WEP_POSSPESEN_FW END) AS WEPS_NETTOWERT FROM WWS.WEP_WWSERKONTROLLEPOS WEP GROUP BY WEP.WEP_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) WEPS ON (WEPS.WEP_ERKONTRKOPF_ID = WER.WER_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) GROUP BY WER.WER_FIRMENNR, WER.WER_FIBUNR, WER.WER_ERFASSNR )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWJ_VA_WLZLAJSUM ( VWJ_LAJ_FIRMENNR, VWJ_LAJ_LAGERJOURNALLFDNR, VWJ_BETRAG_EW, VWJ_BETRAG_FW, VWJ_BETRAG_MW, VWJ_BETRAG_EW_AKTIV, VWJ_BETRAG_FW_AKTIV, VWJ_BETRAG_MW_AKTIV ) AS (SELECT WLZ_LAJ_FIRMENNR, WLZ_LAJ_LAGERJOURNALLFDNR, SUM(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 0 THEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_EW, SUM(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 1 THEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_FW, SUM(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 2 THEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_MW, MAX(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_EW_AKTIV, MAX(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_FW_AKTIV, MAX(CASE WHEN WLZ.WLZ_BETRAG_KZ = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WLZ_BETRAG_MW_AKTIV FROM WWS.WLZ_WESLAJ_ZUORDNUNG WLZ INNER JOIN WWS.WEI_WARENEINSATZKOPF WEI ON (WLZ.WLZ_WEINSATZKOPFID = WEI.WEI_WEINSATZKOPFID) INNER JOIN WWS.WEB_WARENEINSATZBUCH WEB ON (WLZ.WLZ_WEINSATZKOPFID = WEB.WEB_WEINSATZKOPFID AND WLZ.WLZ_WEINSATZBUCHLFDNR = WEB.WEB_WEINSATZBUCHLFDNR) GROUP BY WLZ.WLZ_LAJ_FIRMENNR, WLZ.WLZ_LAJ_LAGERJOURNALLFDNR )

VST_VKUMSATZ_AJ, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 1) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ1 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ4 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 5) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ5 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 6) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ6 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 7) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ7 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 8) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ8 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (VST.VST_VSTATISTIKJAHR * 12 + 9) BETWEEN VFW.VFW_WJBEGINN_VJJM AND VFW.VFW_WJENDE_VJJM THEN VST.VST_VKUMSATZ9 ELSE 0 END),0) + ISNULL(SUM(CASE CREATE VIEW WWS.VWL_VA_WEINGLIEFARTINFO ( VWL_ARL_FIRMENNR, VWL_ARTIKELNR, VWL_LIEFERANT_FIRMENNR, VWL_LIEFERANT_KLID, VWL_LETZTES_EINGDATUM ) AS ( SELECT WAP.WAP_ARL_FIRMENNR, WAP.WAP_ARTIKELNR, WAK.WAK_LIEFERANT_FIRMENNR, WAK.WAK_LIEFERANT_KLID, MAX(WAK.WAK_EINGANGSDATUM) AS WAK_EINGANGSDATUM FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAP INNER JOIN WWS.WAK_WARENEINGANGKOPF WAK ON (WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAK.WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID) GROUP BY WAP.WAP_ARL_FIRMENNR, WAP.WAP_ARTIKELNR, WAK.WAK_LIEFERANT_FIRMENNR, WAK.WAK_LIEFERANT_KLID )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWP_VIEW_WEINGANGPOSWERTE (VWP_WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWP_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VWP_OFFENE_MENGE, VWP_ZUGEORDNETE_MENGE) AS ( SELECT WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, (ISNULL(WAP_MENGE,0) - ISNULL(VEZ_MENGE,0)) AS OFFENE_MENGE, VEZ_MENGE FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAP LEFT JOIN WWS.VEZ_VIEW_WWSERKZU_SUM VEZ ON ( VEZ.VEZ_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AND VEZ.VEZ_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR= WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR) )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWR_VA_WEINGPOS_ERINFO ( VWR_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWR_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VWR_WEU_MENGE, VWR_ERB_MENGE, VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS) AS WITH WAPREC(WAPM_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPM_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPD_SETPOSKZ, WAP_MENGE, SATZART) AS ( SELECT WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AS WAPM_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAPM_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AS WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR, WAP_SETPOSKZ AS WAPD_SETPOSKZ, WAP_MENGE AS WAP_MENGE, 0 AS SATZART FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAPM /*DIE DETAIL ZU EINEM MASTER ERMITTELN*/ UNION ALL SELECT WAPM.WAPM_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPM.WAPM_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPD.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AS WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPD.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, NULL AS WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPD.WAP_SETPOSKZ AS WAPD_SETPOSKZ, WAPD.WAP_MENGE AS WAP_MENGE, 1 AS SATZART FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAPD INNER JOIN WAPREC WAPM ON (WAPM.WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAPD.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WAPM.WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = WAPD.WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR) WHERE (WAPM.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 1 OR WAPM.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 3) AND (WAPM.SATZART = 0 OR WAPM.SATZART = 1) /*DEN MASTER ZU DEN DETAILS ERMITTELN*/ UNION ALL SELECT WAPD.WAPM_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPD.WAPM_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPM.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AS WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPM.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPM.WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPM.WAP_SETPOSKZ AS WAPD_SETPOSKZ, WAPM.WAP_MENGE AS WAP_MENGE, 2 AS SATZART FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAPM INNER JOIN WAPREC WAPD ON (WAPM.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAPD.WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WAPM.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = WAPD.WAP_PARENT_WEINGPOSLFDNR) WHERE (WAPD.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 2 OR WAPD.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 3) AND (WAPD.SATZART = 0 OR WAPD.SATZART = 2) ), WEUWAPINFO (WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAP_WEU_MENGE, WAP_ERB_MENGE) AS ( SELECT WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID AS WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR AS WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, SUM(WEU.WEU_MENGE) AS WAP_WEU_MENGE, SUM(CASE WHEN ERB_BUCHUNGSTATUS = 9 THEN WEU.WEU_MENGE END) AS WAP_ERB_MENGE /*NULL WENN NIX*/ FROM WWS.WEU_WWSERKONTROLLEZU WEU INNER JOIN WWS.WER_WWSERKONTROLLEKOPF WER ON (WER.WER_ERKONTRKOPF_ID = WEU.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) INNER JOIN FIBU.ERB_BUCHUNG ERB ON (ERB.ERB_FIRMENNR = WER.WER_FIRMENNR AND ERB.ERB_FIBUNR = WER.WER_FIBUNR AND ERB.ERB_ERFASSNR = WER.WER_ERFASSNR) WHERE ISNULL(WEU.WEU_EINGANGSRECHNUNGSART,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(WEU.WEU_SATZKZ,0) IN (0,3,4) GROUP BY WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR ) SELECT WAPM_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPM_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, SUM(CASE WHEN WAP.SATZART = 0 THEN ERI.WAP_WEU_MENGE END) AS VWR_WEU_MENGE, SUM(CASE WHEN WAP.SATZART = 0 THEN ERI.WAP_ERB_MENGE END) AS VWR_ERB_MENGE, (CASE WHEN COUNT(ERI.WAP_WEU_MENGE) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT ZUGEORDNET, NICHT MIT MENGE 0 PRUEFEN */ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_WEU_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_WEU_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 0 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_WEU_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, (CASE WHEN COUNT(ERI.WAP_ERB_MENGE) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT VERBUCHTE SAETZE*/ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_ERB_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_ERB_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN WAP.WAPD_SETPOSKZ = 0 THEN (CASE WHEN WAP.WAP_MENGE = ERI.WAP_ERB_MENGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) = 1 THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS FROM WAPREC WAP LEFT JOIN WEUWAPINFO ERI ON (WAP.WAPD_WARENEINGKOPFID = ERI.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WAP.WAPD_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = ERI.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR) WHERE WAPD_SETPOSKZ <> 3 OR WAPD_SETPOSKZ IS NULL GROUP BY CREATE VIEW WWS.VWT_VA_WEINGKOPF_ERINFO ( VWT_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWT_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, VWT_VERBUCHTSTATUS) AS ( SELECT VWR.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, (CASE WHEN MIN(VWR.VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS) = 2 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(VWR.VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, (CASE WHEN MIN(VWR.VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS) = 2 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(VWR.VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS FROM (SELECT WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(WEX.VWR_WEU_MENGE,0) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT*/ WHEN ISNULL(WEX.VWR_WEU_MENGE,0) = ISNULL(WAP.WAP_MENGE,0) THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VWR_ZUGEORDNETSTATUS, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(WEX.VWR_ERB_MENGE,0) = 0 THEN 0 /*NICHT*/ WHEN ISNULL(WEX.VWR_ERB_MENGE,0) = ISNULL(WAP.WAP_MENGE,0) THEN 2 /*VOLLSTAENDIG*/ ELSE 1 /*TEILWEISE*/ END) AS VWR_VERBUCHTSTATUS FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAP LEFT JOIN (SELECT WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, SUM(WEU.WEU_MENGE) AS VWR_WEU_MENGE, SUM(CASE WHEN ERB_BUCHUNGSTATUS = 9 THEN WEU.WEU_MENGE ELSE 0 END) AS VWR_ERB_MENGE FROM WWS.WEU_WWSERKONTROLLEZU WEU INNER JOIN WWS.WER_WWSERKONTROLLEKOPF WER ON (WER.WER_ERKONTRKOPF_ID = WEU.WEU_ERKONTRKOPF_ID) INNER JOIN FIBU.ERB_BUCHUNG ERB ON (ERB.ERB_FIRMENNR = WER.WER_FIRMENNR AND ERB.ERB_FIBUNR = WER.WER_FIBUNR AND ERB.ERB_ERFASSNR = WER.WER_ERFASSNR) WHERE ISNULL(WEU.WEU_EINGANGSRECHNUNGSART,0) = 0 GROUP BY WEU.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID, WEU.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR) WEX ON (WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID = WEX.WEU_WAK_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = WEX.WEU_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR)) VWR GROUP BY VWR.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID )

CREATE VIEW WWS.VWU_VA_WAPZUORDINFO ( VWU_WARENEINGKOPFID, VWU_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, VWU_EING_MENGE, VWU_VERW_MENGE, VWU_OFFENE_MENGE ) AS ( SELECT WAPR.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAPR.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, WAPR.WAP_MENGE, WAPR.VERWMENGE, (CASE WHEN WAPR.WAP_MENGE > 0 AND WAPR.VERWMENGE > WAPR.WAP_MENGE THEN 0 WHEN WAPR.WAP_MENGE < 0 AND WAPR.VERWMENGE < WAPR.WAP_MENGE THEN 0 ELSE WAPR.WAP_MENGE - WAPR.VERWMENGE END) AS OFFEN FROM ( SELECT WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID, WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR, MAX(WAP.WAP_MENGE) AS WAP_MENGE, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ELVERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ = WAP.WAP_EINHEITKBEZ THEN ELVERP.ELV_ZLMENGE ELSE ELVERP.ELV_ZLMENGE * ELVERP.ERP_EINHEITENFAKTOR / (CASE WHEN BPP.BPP_FIRMENNR IS NULL THEN WAP.WAP_EINHEITENFAKTOR ELSE BPP.BPP_EINHEITENFAKTOR END) END),0)+ ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LPOERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ = WAP.WAP_EINHEITKBEZ THEN LPOERP.LPO_MENGE ELSE LPOERP.LPO_MENGE * LPOERP.ERP_EINHEITENFAKTOR / (CASE WHEN BPP.BPP_FIRMENNR IS NULL THEN WAP.WAP_EINHEITENFAKTOR ELSE BPP.BPP_EINHEITENFAKTOR END) END),0) AS VERWMENGE FROM WWS.WAP_WARENEINGANGPOSITION WAP LEFT JOIN WWS.BPP_BESTPOSITION BPP ON (WAP.WAP_BPD_FIRMENNR = BPP.BPP_FIRMENNR AND WAP.WAP_BPD_ERFASSUNGSKZ = BPP.BPP_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR = BPP.BPP_BESTPRODERFASSUNGSNR AND WAP.WAP_BPD_BESTPOSLFDNR = BPP.BPP_BESTPOSLFDNR) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM WWS.WAZ_WARENZUORDNUNG WAZE WHERE WAZE.WAZ_WARENZUORDNUNGSKZ = 0 OR WAZE.WAZ_WARENZUORDNUNGSKZ IS NULL) WAZ ON (WAP.WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID = WAZ.WAZ_WAP_WARENEINGKOPFID AND WAP.WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR = WAZ.WAZ_WAP_WARENEINGPOSLFDNR) LEFT ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSNR = ELV.ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR AND ERP.ERP_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = ELV.ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR)) ELVERP ON (ELVERP.ELV_FIRMENNR = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_FIRMENNR AND ELVERP.ELV_ERFASSUNGSKZ = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND ELVERP.ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_ERFASSUNGSNR AND ELVERP.ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_ERFASSPOSLFDNR AND ELVERP.ELV_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_ERFASSPOSORIGLFDNR AND ELVERP.ELV_ERFASSPOSLVLFDNR = WAZ.WAZ_ELV_ERFASSPOSLVLFDNR) LEFT JOIN (SELECT LPO.LPO_FIRMENNR, LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINLFDNR, LPO.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOSLFDNR, LPO.LPO_MENGE, ERP.ERP_EINHEITKBEZ, ERP.ERP_EINHEITENFAKTOR FROM WWS.LPO_LIEFERSCHEINPOS LPO INNER JOIN WWS.ERP_ERFASSPOSITIONEN ERP ON (ERP.ERP_FIRMENNR = LPO.LPO_FIRMENNR AND ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSKZ = LPO.LPO_ERFASSUNGSKZ AND ERP.ERP_ERFASSUNGSNR = LPO.LPO_ERFASSUNGSNR AND ERP.ERP_ERFASSPOSLFDNR = LPO.LPO_ERFASSPOSLFDNR)) LPOERP ON (LPOERP.LPO_FIRMENNR = WAZ.WAZ_LFS_FIRMENNR AND
